description: This file declares a utility function 'checkForNan' that checks for NaN values in a tensor within the c10d distributed namespace, conditioned on the USE_C10D_NCCL macro. It includes necessary headers for tensor operations and CUDA stream management.

methods.name: checkForNan
methods.description: Checks for NaN values in the provided tensor on a specified CUDA stream; throws an error if any NaNs are found.
